name: Band-Pass Test for Noise
aliases: Yoon et al. Band-Pass Noise Metric
definition: A tool by Yoon et al. to measure how band-pass the noise is, inspired by wavelet noise. It is based on the difference between the noise and a down-up-sampled version of the noise.
summary: The Band-Pass Test for Noise quantifies band-pass characteristics by comparing a noise function to its down-up-sampled version, distinguishing it from amplitude or periodicity tests.
